compareDisposition.rationale: No distinct two-source pairing adds more than this passage and its existing Scripture connections.

observations.body: Jerusalem hears that Samaria has received God’s word and sends Peter and John, who pray and lay hands.
observations.label: Reception

observations.body: Simon sees the Spirit given and offers money for the same authority.
observations.label: Offer

observations.body: Peter rejects the exchange, names the state of Simon’s heart, calls for repentance, and receives a request for prayer.
observations.label: Reply

payload.posture: Distinguish the Samaritan believers, the apostles’ actions, Simon’s observation and offer, and Peter’s reply.
payload.tension: The scene places received gift beside an attempt to acquire authority through payment.
payload.title: Peter and John in Samaria
